summary: Tested Wayly Social OS Phase 1 — Marketing Asset library (admin, /admin/marketing-assets) + /api/mkt/* shared backend. Backend: 15/15 pytest pass (campaigns CRUD, single+bulk-zip upload with unsafe-path skip, draft/approve lifecycle, approval-gated public media 404→200, ETag 304, manifest JSON+CSV approved-only + admin-auth required, patch/delete soft-delete, filters/search). UI: Marketing Assets page loads at /admin/marketing-assets, nav testid 'admin-nav-marketing-assets' present, stats row (Total/Approved/Draft/Campaigns) renders, single-file upload submits and a new DRAFT card appears in grid, approval gate is proven end-to-end from the UI (uploaded draft asset → public URL returned 404 without auth; after clicking mkt-approve in the drawer → SAME URL returned 200 image/png). Filters UI renders (campaign/platform/type/approval selects + search). No critical UI bugs found; no API 5xx seen.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/mkt1.py — Public media route correctly gates on approval_status=='approved' AND is_deleted!=true, and guards filename match (prevents id-hopping with wrong filename). Cache-Control immutable is sent at the app layer but stripped to no-store by the platform ingress — expected per main-agent note; ETag/304 still works.

lib/mkt_storage.py — EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is used as the storage init key. If EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is unset in prod this silently POSTs init with None; storage would 4xx. Consider raising if missing at startup.

mkt1.py:_ingest_zip — path-traversal protection is good (startswith('/'), '..' in parts, ':' check). Note: Windows drive-letter colon check is a false positive on filenames legitimately containing ':' but files like that are already unsupported.

Admin UI AdminMarketingAssets.jsx — Good data-testid coverage (upload form, filters, grid cards mkt-asset-{id}, drawer fields, approve/reject/delete, manifest downloads). No hardcoded API URLs — uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on core flows verified (load, upload→draft, approval-gate 404→200). Drawer-save / manifest-download / soft-delete flows proven at backend layer; one UI re-open-after-approve retry hit test-side timing flakiness unrelated to product.

seed_data_creation: Pytest created 1 campaign (test-iter417-<ts>) + ~4 assets, all soft-deleted by autouse teardown. UI runs created 2 TEST_ campaigns (test-ui-iter417-<ts>, test-ui-iter417b-<ts>) with 3 approved assets left over in the first campaign (2 'Crisp Master' dupes + 1 'UI test topic') and the 417b asset deleted. Main agent may wish to soft-delete those 3 UI residuals via DELETE /api/mkt/assets/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable backend pytest: /app/backend/tests/test_mkt1_phase1_iter417.py (admin 2FA via pyotp + TOTP M5A7R2XCCEXWYYKNJY55MVZYUHPYFA6W, 15 tests, idempotent, uses module-scoped cleanup). Admin console UI auth works by minting token via the 2-step API and injecting into localStorage key 'wayly_admin_token' then navigating to /admin/marketing-assets. Phase 2 (Canva export) and Phase 3 (Buffer attach) are NOT built — do not test.
